action.objective: Convert the attack; keep the king safe and avoid losing material needlessly.
action.rationale: Only g2g3 is commit-ready. Its exact -1181 at depth 2 is the strongest and only safe verified option; Qc8 was refuted by Rxg2#, and other queens moves (Qh7+/Qf7+ allowed Kxh7/Kxf7) lose the queen. g3 is not check, but it does not blunder mate: the earlier safety probe found no forced short mate after it, and the position remains materially difficult. Given remaining_nodes=0, analysis is unavailable; commit the single verified move.
